title: Consideration.
bodyText: Except as provided in its articles or bylaws, a corporation may admit members for no consideration or for such consideration as is determined by the board.
bodyHtml: [§414D-82]  Consideration.  Except as provided in its articles or bylaws, a corporation may admit members for no consideration or for such consideration as is determined by the board. [L 2001, c 105, pt of §1]
